name: admin_command
description: An admin command completed. Emitted once for every command processed by the running validator, whether it succeeded or failed.

type.description: The admin command that was processed.

result.description: The result of processing the admin command.

unknown_command.description: The running validator does not recognize this command.

abi_version_mismatch.description: The request used an unsupported admin command ABI version.

abi_size_mismatch.description: The request size did not match the admin command ABI.

unsupported.description: The command is not supported by this validator configuration.

custom.description: The command returned a command-specific result described by custom_result.

custom_result.description: The command-specific result when result is custom.

start_time.description: Wall-clock nanosecond unix timestamp at which the command started getting processed.

end_time.description: Wall-clock nanosecond unix timestamp at which the command completed.

payload_version.description: Payload version requested by the command. Valid only when has_payload_version is true.

has_payload_version.description: Whether the command payload was large enough to contain payload_version.

payload_size.description: Size of the received command payload in bytes.

args_json.description: Command-specific public values serialized as JSON. Unavailable values are omitted. Private key material is never included.
